hero.title: File:Kukenan Roraima GS.jpg
hero.description: Morning view of Kukenan and Roraima tepuis, from Tëk river camp (river visible in the image), in Gran Sabana, Venezuela. Roraima tepui is actually some 100 mts higher than Kukenan, but due to the perspective of the picture, it looks like it is lower.
